title: CDS view activation fails with "Use of annotation 'ObjectModel.compositionRoot' is not permitted (not released)" in ABAP Cloud
symptom:
Syntax error during CDS DDL activation:
Use of annotation 'ObjectModel.compositionRoot' is not permitted (not released)
rootCause:
The classic ObjectModel.* annotations belong to the older BOPF-based "ABAP Programming Model for SAP Fiori" and are not released for the ABAP Cloud development model (S/4HANA Cloud ABAP Environment / BTP ABAP Environment, formerly "Embedded Steampunk") — only the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) is released there.

Source: SAP Community blog "Embedded Steampunk – What's under the hood Part II"; corroborated by an SAP Community thread on the same CDS annotation error.

solutions.label: Re-model the business object with RAP instead of legacy ObjectModel annotations
solutions.body:
Remove the ObjectModel.compositionRoot / ObjectModel.association.type annotations from the CDS view.
Create a Behavior Definition for the root entity and model compositions using RAP's "composition" syntax in the CDS association plus root/composition-child declarations in the BDEF instead of the BOPF-oriented annotations.
Activate the CDS view + BDEF + service definition/binding as a RAP business object.

solutions.label: Keep the legacy-annotated view out of ABAP Cloud packages
solutions.body: If the object genuinely must stay on the classic (on-premise, non-cloud) programming model, keep it in a package/system that is not exposed to the ABAP Cloud development model, since ObjectModel.* + BOPF is not supported there at all.

prevention: Run the ATC "Cloud readiness"/released-API check on any CDS view copied from an on-premise template before moving it into an S/4HANA Cloud or BTP ABAP Environment package.
